parameters.jsonBody:
={{
JSON.stringify({
  model: "llama-3.1-8b-instant",
  messages: [
    {
      role: "system",
      content: "You are a POD slogan writer. Each slogan you write will be printed on a t-shirt alongside a matching illustration. Return only valid JSON."
    },
    {
      role: "user",
      content:
        'Niche: "' + $json.niche + '"\n\n' +
        'Typography signals:\n' +
        '- Font style: ' + $json.typography.dominantFontStyle + '\n' +
        '- Mood: ' + $json.typography.letteringMood + '\n' +
        '- Layout: ' + $json.typography.textLayout + '\n' +
        '- Suggested phrases from market: ' +
        (($json.typography.suggestedPhrases || []).join(', ')) +
        '\n\n' +
        'Generate 5 original slogans for this niche. Each slogan must:\n' +
        '- Be 1-5 words, printable on a t-shirt.\n' +
        '- Be completely original (do not copy or closely paraphrase the suggested phrases).\n' +
        '- Have a matching illustration concept.\n' +
        '- Feel authentic to this niche.\n\n' +
        'Return ONLY this JSON array:\n' +
        '[{\n' +
        '  "slogan": "the text on the shirt",\n' +
        '  "illustrationConcept": "what artwork sits beside or behind the slogan",\n' +
        '  "placement": "e.g. slogan above illustration, centered chest",\n' +
        '  "mood": "e.g. bold and rebellious"\n' +
        '}]'
    }
  ],
  max_tokens: 600,
  temperature: 0.85
})
}}
